name: Hentai Prison
source:
-"Tulip Prison"
This is where the worst of the worst, the ones deemed "beyond redemption," are locked up. The legendary Ninth Correctional Precinct was an inescapable fortress, constructed on a remote island far out in the open seas.

Once upon a time, in the bustling metropolis of Tokyo, there lived an eccentric young man named Minato Shuuichirou. He was infamous among law enforcement as the "Flasher." Shuuichirou absolutely loathed the idea of clothing, and being stark naked was just second nature to him.

He was a daredevil who lived life on the edge, never hesitating to put his neck on the line time and time again. Then, one fateful sunny day, his luck ran out, and he was arrested for public indecency and obstruction of justice.

In court, he passionately defended his actions, claiming his brazen exhibitions were a form of art. Nonetheless, his arguments landed with a thud, as the bewildered listeners couldn't wrap their heads around such an offbeat perspective. He was ultimately convicted of assaulting a police officer and multiple counts of indecent exposure, earning him a 10-year sentence filled with back-breaking labor.

To make matters worse, he was considered "beyond rehabilitation" and banished to the notorious Tulip Prison.

Can this daring exhibitionist make it in a prison packed with shady characters? This institution, ominously nicknamed "HENTAI," is anything but a picnic for the unlucky folks stuck inside.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://qruppo.com/products/henpri/]official website[/url]]
translation:
——《郁金香监狱》这里关押着最糟糕的人，那些被认为“无法救赎”的人。传说中的第九惩教分局是一座无法逃脱的堡垒，建在远离公海的一座偏远岛屿上。

从前，在繁华的大都市东京，住着一位性格古怪的年轻人，名叫港秀一郎。他在执法部门中被称为“闪光者”。修一郎绝对讨厌穿衣服，赤身裸体对他来说只是第二天性。

他是一个胆大妄为的人，​​生活在边缘，一次又一次地冒着生命危险，从不犹豫。然后，在一个决定命运的晴天，他的运气耗尽了，他因公然猥亵和妨碍司法公正而被捕。

在法庭上，他热情地为自己的行为辩护，声称他厚颜无耻的展览是一种艺术形式。尽管如此，他的论点还是引起了轰动，因为困惑的听众无法理解这种另类的观点。他最终因袭警和多项猥亵罪被定罪，并被判处10年徒刑和劳役。

更糟糕的是，他被认为“无法康复”并被流放到臭名昭著的郁金香监狱。

这位大胆的暴露狂能否在充满可疑人物的监狱里安然度过呢？这个机构有一个不祥的绰号“HENTAI”，对于困在里面的不幸的人来说，它绝对不是野餐场所。
